en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tranquil pond bordered by trees, with the reflection of the trees in the water. In the background, partly obscured by trees, stands a large historic castle complex with towers and a steep roof. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as a view near the castle in Rochlitz, and the publisher information appears along the lower margin.
